name: Bersama Mencapai Puncak Tbk.
summary: PT Bersama Mencapai Puncak Tbk is primarily engaged in the management and operation of a chain of restaurants. In addition to its culinary ventures, the company also participates in the trade of raw materials, specifically frozen food items and groceries. Founded in 2015, this Indonesian firm maintains its principal office in Malang. It operates as a subsidiary under the corporate structure of PT Anak Baik Sejahtera.
